changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE gateway_routes ( id VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY, uri VARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL, predicates JSONB NOT NULL, filters JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, route_order INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, metadata JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() );
CREATE INDEX gateway_routes_enabled_order_idx ON gateway_routes (enabled, route_order);
